meta.aciklama:
14 free agent skills by Jakub Krehel that teach your coding agent to build better interfaces.

You get UI, typography, colour, accessibility, layout and product writing. Better Interface reviews a screen or a whole flow and returns one ranked report. Explain Interface tells you how a website, an effect or an animation was built, from a live URL or a screenshot. Variant builds several versions of a component so you can pick one.

You've also got Interface Review for a branch or pull request, Build Design for turning a Figma file or a design image into UI, and Better Accessibility for checks against WCAG 2.2.

Install with npx skills add, or as a Claude Code plugin. The catch? Some only run when you call them by name. I'd start with Better Interface.

Repo: https://github.com/jakubkrehel/skills

Save this before your next UI pass.

#uidesign #claudecode #agentskills
